title: Certified multiobjective allocation with multiple reference profiles: reproducibility package
description: Experimental code, instance manifests, numerical results and independently checkable certificates for multiple-reference-profile resource allocation with strict service priorities. The package includes the historical code and results, corrected verification, a reanalysis of 55 boundary cases, and a demand-trace study. The software is licensed under MIT; original results and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0. The UCI electricity dataset retains its own license and is downloaded separately; it is not redistributed in this package.
